tailored:
Dear Lucid Labs team,

What drew me to this posting is that you measure "good" instead of assuming it. In my TalentHiv project I built AI-driven CV screening with LangChain and Azure OpenAI, and the hardest part was exactly what you describe: defining what a correct result looks like and proving the system hits it. I built validation, error handling and Pytest testing around it, deployed it on Azure App Service with Key Vault, and implemented GDPR data-export and deletion so the system could survive real-world requirements rather than demo conditions.

Your emphasis on production frontend rather than throwaway prototypes matches how I work: TalentHiv's frontend is Next.js/React/TypeScript with proper typing, and on VoiceHive Hotels I built a real-time multilingual voice assistant with FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes, where I had to design for cost and latency rather than convenience.

Twenty years leading operational teams at Casino Cosmopol in a strictly regulated environment taught me the habits your posting asks for: incident handling, documentation nobody has to chase me for, and escalating problems early instead of collecting them.

I am an EU citizen with a full work permit in Sweden and can work in Germany. English is my native language; my Swedish is at a good level, in daily use. I have no German.

I would welcome the chance to talk.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
